scripts.name: AccuLynx Send
scripts.description: Terros to AccuLynx. Install once per AccuLynx location, with that location's API key.

configSchema.name: recordType
configSchema.description: Required, no default. 'contact' creates an AccuLynx contact; 'job' creates a contact and a job for it. The new ID is saved as the account's externalLeadId and the account is not sent again.

configSchema.name: contactTypeId
configSchema.description: Optional. AccuLynx contact type ID for new contacts. When blank, Send uses the location's default type, preferring a default named Customer.

configSchema.name: leadSourceId
configSchema.description: Optional. AccuLynx lead source ID for new jobs.

configSchema.name: triggerStages
configSchema.description: Optional comma-separated Terros stage IDs (S.*), recommended because IDs survive renames. Existing stage-name values remain supported and match without case or surrounding whitespace. Blank sends accounts at any stage.

configSchema.name: accountFilterField
configSchema.description: Optional. Dotted Terros account field that decides which AccuLynx location an account belongs to. For team fields (owner.teamIds, owner.memberOf, teamId, or team), an assigned account team is matched alone; otherwise the configured field is used as the fallback. Lists match when any team ID or name is allowed. Blank sends every account.

configSchema.name: accountFilterValues
configSchema.description: Comma-separated values of accountFilterField that this install (this location) sends.

configSchema.name: addressCountry
configSchema.description: Optional fallback two-letter country code (such as US or CA) for job addresses. Account webhooks historically omitted country; Send now uses the webhook country when present and this setting when it is missing. Without either, jobs are created with no address.

configSchema.name: testMode
configSchema.description: Safety switch, off by default. Turn on to check the API key and log qualifying accounts, team-routing paths and values, skip reasons, exact payloads, and API diagnostics without writing to AccuLynx or Terros.

authSchema.apiKey: AccuLynx API key for one location (Account Settings > API Keys)

scripts.name: AccuLynx Webhook
scripts.description: AccuLynx to Terros. Subscribe this URL to milestone, milestone-status, and company-representative changes for one AccuLynx location.

configSchema.name: workflowId
configSchema.description: Required. Terros workflow ID (WF.*) whose stage is set from the AccuLynx milestone and current status

configSchema.name: requestType
configSchema.description: Required, no default. 'update' (recommended) moves only accounts linked to the job by AccuLynx Send; 'upsert' also creates an account for a job started in AccuLynx.

configSchema.name: subscriptionId
configSchema.description: Optional. AccuLynx webhook subscription ID of this location. Events naming any other subscription are refused. This routes events between locations; it is not authentication.

configSchema.name: accountSource
configSchema.description: Terros accountSource to record on the account (defaults to 'AccuLynx')

configSchema.name: milestoneStageMapping
configSchema.description: Optional legacy override from 'Milestone > Status' or milestone-only AccuLynx names to Terros stage/action IDs (S.* / A.*). Name-valued targets are ignored. A status key falls back to its milestone key. Without this override, the AccuLynx source value is resolved through the workflow Integration Mapping.

authSchema.apiKey: AccuLynx API key for the same location (Account Settings > API Keys)
